features.name: duration_zero_flag
features.description: Indicator that call duration is zero, implying no real contact occurred.
features.expected_model_benefit: Tree can isolate trivially non-converting contacts with a single split.

features.name: duration_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket of call duration in seconds (0=<60, 1=60-180, 2=180-360, 3=360-600, 4=>600).
features.expected_model_benefit: Compact ordinal feature aligns with strong nonlinear effect of duration on conversion.

features.name: log_duration
features.description: Log-scaled duration to compress long tail for cleaner threshold splits.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides monotonic compressed signal; helps tree thresholds in low-duration region.

features.name: never_contacted_before
features.description: Boolean indicator that the client was never previously contacted (pdays sentinel 999).
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates first-time contacts from repeat targets, a strong split point.

features.name: recent_contact_flag
features.description: Indicator that pdays is small (<=7), meaning very recent prior contact.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures hot-lead recency interaction with previous campaign.

features.name: campaign_pressure_bucket
features.description: Bucketed contact intensity in current campaign (0=1, 1=2-3, 2=4-6, 3=>=7).
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes diminishing returns / fatigue from repeated contacts.

features.name: prior_success_signal
features.description: Composite signal: had previous contacts and pdays not sentinel, weighted by previous count.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines prior outreach history into one splittable score.

features.name: age_bucket
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-monotonic age effect (young and retired tend to convert more).

features.name: macro_stress_score
features.description: Macroeconomic stress proxy combining negative emp.var.rate and high euribor3m and nr.employed.
features.expected_model_benefit: One axis summarizing macro climate which strongly shifts baseline conversion rate.

features.name: favorable_macro_flag
features.description: Indicator of low-rate, contracting-employment regime historically more receptive to deposit offers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Single-split capture of macro regime favoring conversion.

features.name: cellular_contact_flag
features.description: Semantic indicator that the contact channel is cellular (encoded value 0 in contact field based on observed coding), which historically yields higher response than telephone.
features.expected_model_benefit: Tree can use channel quality as a top-level split.

features.name: client_risk_profile
features.description: Ordinal semantic risk profile based on combination of default, housing loan, and personal loan status: 0=clean, 1=has one obligation, 2=multiple obligations or default indication, 3=highest risk.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines credit-related fields into a single ordinal axis that trees can split for risk-aware segmentation.
